subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Is the PR body's redacted predicate transcript plus fault-injected runner/session tests enough proof for this retry/session-safety change, or should a maintainer require full-runner/gateway proof before merge?
rationale: The code shape appears appropriate, but the change affects retry ordering, session-state safety, and message delivery after provider failures; accepting the proof level is a maintainer risk decision.

options.title: Require full-runner or gateway proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, gateway logs, or a linked artifact showing the retry warning, recovered reply, and no duplicate side effects in a realistic setup before merge.

options.title: Accept current proof and review semantics
options.body: Treat the PR's production-predicate transcript and fault-injected runner tests as sufficient, then proceed with maintainer review of the retry contract.

options.title: Choose another canonical PR
options.body: Pause this PR and select another open candidate for the linked issue if its proof or implementation is preferred.

recommendation.title: Require full-runner or gateway proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, gateway logs, or a linked artifact showing the retry warning, recovered reply, and no duplicate side effects in a realistic setup before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: GitHub history shows recent substantive ownership of the embedded runner terminal/retry area and adjacent post-tool reply behavior.
